title: Sparkly pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pencil body -->
  <g transform="rotate(-35 50 50)">
    <!-- Main yellow body -->
    <rect x="38" y="20" width="24" height="50" rx="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
    <!-- Lighter highlight stripe on body -->
    <rect x="42" y="20" width="6" height="50" fill="#FFE84D"/>
    <!-- Wood cone -->
    <polygon points="38,70 62,70 50,88" fill="#F0C080"/>
    <!-- Lighter wood highlight -->
    <polygon points="44,70 56,70 50,82" fill="#FFD9A8"/>
    <!-- Graphite tip -->
    <polygon points="45,82 55,82 50,90" fill="#5A6B8A"/>
    <!-- Metal ferrule -->
    <rect x="38" y="14" width="24" height="7" rx="1" fill="#B0B8C8"/>
    <!-- Ferrule stripes -->
    <rect x="38" y="16" width="24" height="2" fill="#D0D8E8"/>
    <rect x="38" y="20" width="24" height="2" fill="#9098A8"/>
    <!-- Eraser -->
    <rect x="39" y="8" width="22" height="7" rx="3" fill="#FF8A9E"/>
    <!-- Eraser highlight -->
    <rect x="42" y="9" width="8" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFB3C1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Top-right sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(75,20)">
    <polygon points="0,-7 1.5,-1.5 7,0 1.5,1.5 0,7 -1.5,1.5 -7,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#FFF176"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Middle-left sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(18,45)">
    <polygon points="0,-5 1,-1 5,0 1,1 0,5 -1,1 -5,0 -1,-1" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bottom-right sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(72,72)">
    <polygon points="0,-6 1.2,-1.2 6,0 1.2,1.2 0,6 -1.2,1.2 -6,0 -1.2,-1.2" fill="#FFEE58"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small top sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(30,15)">
    <polygon points="0,-4 0.8,-0.8 4,0 0.8,0.8 0,4 -0.8,0.8 -4,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#FFFDE7"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny bottom sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(25,80)">
    <polygon points="0,-3.5 0.7,-0.7 3.5,0 0.7,0.7 0,3.5 -0.7,0.7 -3.5,0 -0.7,-0.7" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small right sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(85,55)">
    <polygon points="0,-4 0.8,-0.8 4,0 0.8,0.8 0,4 -0.8,0.8 -4,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Extra tiny sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx="65" cy="32" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="62" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="82" r="1.3" fill="#FFFDE7"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="30" r="1" fill="#FFFDE7"/>
</svg>
